method: Read-only exact Git blobs plus equal live files; no product/toolchain/test execution, no target access. Existing tests inspected as source only.

stop_composition.finding: poll checks operation ledger first then local real cancellation/deadline; check polls without charging; charge polls, checks local admission, charges operation ledger then local usage. Refused work is not charged; admitted charges are not refunded. Cancellation after admission is detected at the next cooperative checkpoint.

poll/charge/check preserve the existing recovery StopReason vocabulary: real cancellation is Cancelled; elapsed deadline is Interrupted(jre_budget_interrupted), not a new prefix-specific reason. No lossless original reader Error identity is claimed. Counted refusal retains its dimension and position; emission normalizes OutputBytes written/limit to its buffer counters by existing contract.

StaticPrefixReturn::prove returns Result<Option<certificate>,StopReason>; every fallible poll/charge and called SSA/effects helper is propagated with ?. Missing facts/mismatch alone returns Ok(None). No stop-to-None adapter, catch/retry or partial ownership is published. Final poll occurs immediately before Some; build itself propagates ?. This is a cooperative observed-stop property, not an assertion that time/token cannot change between checkpoints.

After complete certificate, return creates one typed Field/PrefixUpdate AST. adapt_return is Result<Expr,String> ordinary type adaptation, not a swallowed StopReason channel; pushes remain Result. build failure exits report through stopped rather than continuing successor construction.

PrefixUpdate writes operator via put? then returns operand Result. operand propagates grouping and child expr writes. Sole commit put polls/checks/charges before append, discards staged text on stop; emit finishes only on Ok. Commit pass records no source-map table. Previously admitted output usage remains real; failed append adds none.

Only successful full emission proceeds to committed field presentations. A stop in emission or that presentation admission returns stopped with original StopReason, current usage, stop diagnostic, empty text/fields/maps and not-produced artifact.

phase_qualification.finding: Optional evidence/source-map replay follows complete text emission. A later evidence stop intentionally retains Produced complete body and reports Partial/Cancelled execution plus evidence status; source-map gate error returns default map. This is not a partial prefix body and must not be restated as every stop erases all prior committed artifacts. No claim of whole-operation transactional rollback is supported.

existing_tests_inspected_not_run_here.facts: Real token/ledger cancellation; real elapsed_millis=0 budget rejects OutputBytes and IrItems with Interrupted at23 and zero charge. No fabricated StopReason.

Shared writer admission, prior-charge retention, exact/one-short output refusal and replay atomic node publication have existing concrete tests. These are generic emitter tests, not new prefix dynamic experiments.

Inspected actual measured proof, IrItems one-short at9 and ledger cancellation after final accepted charge; asserts no certificate, exact admitted usage and Cancelled at9. Earlier sealed focused-v3 audit supplies execution evidence; this review does not rerun it.

test_requirement_judgment: The common checked writer plus direct Result composition is sufficient static evidence for this new node to inherit observed deadline/output-stop reason, usage and precommit atomicity. No missing prefix-specific dynamic deadline/output run is disguised as executed coverage. No additional framework or duplicate dedicated test is necessary solely to restate this unchanged common mechanism; a future bypass/new commit boundary would need its own verification.

scope_closure.finding: AttributeShell has only name/span/content_span; MethodFacts has no generic binder; DeclaringClass carries names/flags/member-name projection, not generic/source scope binding. Requiring actual known class/method headers and rejecting class Signature/InnerClasses/EnclosingMethod or current method Signature presence is therefore a conservative absence proof for this leaf, not attribute payload decoding or a conclusion that every such class is unsafe. Other methods Signature is not rejected. Object/no-interface and real-field identifier collision checks also close presently unobserved inherited/value-name contexts. Fixed design explicitly documents this boundary; delta qualifies capability as proved and preserves inability-to-prove refusal.
scope_closure.capability_gap: An otherwise nonconflicting generic class/method or class carrying harmless InnerClasses rows can still be declined. Presence alone does not establish a real shadow/collision. This is a real future admission capability gap, not unsafe successful recovery and not claimed covered by FO success. Expanding it requires adequate typed binding facts, not a global resolver or silently treating attribute absence/presence as semantic equivalence.

limits: Static inspection of fixed c075 only; no new runtime or CI acceptance.
No prefix-specific dynamic deadline or output-limit experiment is asserted.
No guarantee of instantaneous asynchronous cancellation between cooperative checkpoints, no refund, and no rollback of already complete artifact on optional evidence stop.
No general generic/member-scope support, classfile-attribute payload validation, or whole workspace correctness claim.
